api_key_modal_description: The API key you have requested is shown below. Please store it in a safe place, as it will not be shown again.
two_factor_required_desc: Your account must have two-factor authentication enabled in order to continue.
panel_version_desc: This is useful to provide Pyro staff if you run into an unexpected issue.
api_key_description_hint: A description of this API key.
allowed_ips_description: Leave blank to allow any IP address to use this API key, otherwise provide each IP address on a new line. Note: You can also use CIDR ranges here.
delete_api_key_description: All requests using the {identifier} key will be invalidated.
no_api_keys_desc: You haven't created any API keys yet. Create one to get started with the API.
ssh_key_name_desc: A name to identify this SSH key.
delete_ssh_key_description: Removing the {name} SSH key will invalidate its usage across the Panel.
no_ssh_keys_desc: You haven't added any SSH keys yet. Add one to securely access your servers.
no_matching_activity_desc: Try adjusting your filters or search terms to find the activity you're looking for.
no_activity_yet_desc: Activity logs will appear here as you use your account. Check back later or perform some actions to see them here.
language_desc: Choose your preferred language for the panel interface.
password_help: Your new password should be at least 8 characters in length and unique to this website.
email_updated: Your primary email has been updated.
password_required: You must provide your current account password.
password_mismatch: Password confirmation does not match the password you entered.
2fa_enabled: Your account is protected by an authenticator app.
2fa_disabled: You have not configured an authenticator app.
setup_totp_description: You will be required to enter a verification code each time you sign in.
setup_totp_instructions: Scan the QR code above using an authenticator app, or enter the secret code above. Then, enter the 6-digit code it generates below.
activity_desc: Monitor all server activity and track user actions. Filter events, search for specific activities, and export logs for audit purposes.
no_activity_yet_server_desc: Server activity logs will appear here as you manage your server. Start your server or perform actions to see them here.
